def _get_instance(model, pk):
    try:
        return model.objects.get(pk=pk)
    except model.DoesNotExist:
        raise GraphQLError(f"{model.__name__} with id {pk} does not exist.") from None


def _save_instance(instance, data, many_to_many):
    for key, value in data.items():
        if key not in many_to_many:
            setattr(instance, key, value)
    # Only validate what the caller supplied: values the model fills in itself
    # (for example an empty JSON default) would otherwise fail the blank check.
    exclude = [
        field.name
        for field in instance._meta.fields
        if field.name not in data and field.attname not in data
    ]
    try:
        instance.full_clean(exclude=exclude)
    except ValidationError as error:
        raise GraphQLError("; ".join(error.messages)) from error
    instance.save()
    for key, name in many_to_many.items():
        if data.get(key) is not None:
            getattr(instance, name).set(data[key])
    return instance

class Query(graphene.ObjectType):
    item = graphene.Field(ItemType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    item_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(ItemType), required=True)
    counter = graphene.Field(CounterType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    counter_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(CounterType), required=True)
    shipment = graphene.Field(ShipmentType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    shipment_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(ShipmentType), required=True)
    account = graphene.Field(AccountType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    account_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(AccountType), required=True)
    assignment_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(AssignmentType), required=True)
    content_type = graphene.Field(ContentTypeType, id=graphene.ID(required=True))
    content_type_list = graphene.List(graphene.NonNull(ContentTypeType), required=True)

    def resolve_item(root, info, id):
        return Item.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_item_list(root, info):
        return Item.objects.all()

    def resolve_counter(root, info, id):
        return Counter.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_counter_list(root, info):
        return Counter.objects.all()

    def resolve_shipment(root, info, id):
        return Shipment.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_shipment_list(root, info):
        return Shipment.objects.all()

    def resolve_account(root, info, id):
        return Account.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_account_list(root, info):
        return Account.objects.all()

    def resolve_assignment_list(root, info):
        return Assignment.objects.all()

    def resolve_content_type(root, info, id):
        return ContentType.objects.filter(pk=id).first()

    def resolve_content_type_list(root, info):
        return ContentType.objects.all()


class Mutation(graphene.ObjectType):
    create_item = CreateItemMutation.Field()
    update_item = UpdateItemMutation.Field()
    delete_item = DeleteItemMutation.Field()
    create_counter = CreateCounterMutation.Field()
    update_counter = UpdateCounterMutation.Field()
    delete_counter = DeleteCounterMutation.Field()
    create_shipment = CreateShipmentMutation.Field()
    update_shipment = UpdateShipmentMutation.Field()
    delete_shipment = DeleteShipmentMutation.Field()
    create_account = CreateAccountMutation.Field()
    update_account = UpdateAccountMutation.Field()
    delete_account = DeleteAccountMutation.Field()
    create_assignment = CreateAssignmentMutation.Field()
    create_content_type = CreateContentTypeMutation.Field()
    delete_content_type = DeleteContentTypeMutation.Field()


schema = graphene.Schema(query=Query, mutation=Mutation)
